integrity: The proofs use established determinant identities; 6,275 exact finite checks were run, and these do not replace infinite-family proof or constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact real full-data least squares with \(k<n\) hard row equations; not a label-limited estimator or iterative convergence theorem. Primary mathematical proof finite-dimensional; bibliographic equivalence risk remains.
title: Sharp risk and singular-minor deficit for volume-sampled hard constraints in least squares
